duplicate_rules: Never reuse the same topic angle within the next 30 posts.
Avoid near-duplicate titles that target the same intent with only wording changes.
If a topic is already published, mark it archived and do not repeat it unless the angle changes materially.
workflow: Pick the next planned item from the queue.
Check the existing post archive for slug and intent collisions.
Draft the post in the Match by Birth structure.
Show the full draft to the user for approval.
Only after approval, publish live and move the item to published.
Log the final slug and date in the archive so it cannot be repeated.
quality_rules: Tailored to Match by Birth, not generic astrology filler.
Premium, clean, intentional, and easy to scan.
Human-like voice with specific examples and practical takeaways.
No placeholder content, no duplicated sections, no AI slop.
